name: Master Nguyen
guide_text: Early game go for hero powers that give you a gold or buy minions for cheap, late game hope for combat heroes such as Drekthar or Vandar.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 5+ gold. Early on, picking the better buddy is usually more important than picking the better hero power. Hope you can remember them all!
